epita.name: Master's degree in Engineering (Computer Science), specializing in Healthcare and Artificial Intelligence

The program covers programming languages, data structures, databases, and software development methodologies, with a strong emphasis on practical experience through internships and projects. My specialization in Healthcare and Artificial Intelligence included interoperability, cybersecurity, healthcare data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing.
